description: Python interpreter with pip and venv (the python.org NuGet distribution).

postInstall.description: Create the pip/pip3 launchers from the wheel bundled in the package (offline)

features.label: pip
features.missingNote: pip isn't set up in this install. Use Repair to reinstall it.

features.label: venv
features.missingNote: This install has no venv module.

notes: python.org's NuGet package: full standard library with venv and pip (the embeddable ZIP has no pip). After the checksum-verified archive is in place, setup recreates pip.exe offline from the bundled wheel. Packages you install stay inside this install, and the system Python's user packages are hidden from it (PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1). pip.exe records this folder's path, so if you move the whole OpenMind Studio folder, reinstall Python; `python -m pip` works either way. tkinter/IDLE aren't included. python.org publishes no SHA256 for these packages, so each hash was computed from the official download when the version was pinned.
